fieldValues.title: 2. The board model: value and order
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Epic Priority P0 to P2 (rank 1 = P0, 2 = P1, 3+ = P2, unranked = parked), story MoSCoW (Must, Should, Could, Won't) set by a human, a derived 'priority: Pn' label on implementation issues, bump labels (critical-path, blocks-gate, regression), a bug floor of P1, and milestone labels (eight milestone:* labels in semanticops.com and muDemocracy.org). An epic is a release. Defined twice: clerk docs/board.md (Project #6 'SemanticOps') and srs-rust docs/project-management.md (Project #5 'SRS'; says it is canonical).
fieldValues.tensions:
- Two canonical copies. srs-rust's says an epic's Priority is hand-set, its one board input. The clerk's and the handbook's say it is derived from the period ranking by clerk roadmap and 'never set by hand'.
- Two projects carry the same model: #5 has 1,347 items, #6 has 552.
- srs-programme's CLAUDE.md says to reprioritise by editing the period's objective_rank, a third statement of the same rule.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- Which project does clerk board sync write, and does anything still write #5?
- Do milestone:* labels (release names) duplicate epics-as-releases?
fieldValues.next_action: Delete one copy of the board process; make the other the only statement (proposed).
